name: drop2run
description: Publishes a folder, an HTML page, or a markdown note as a static site and returns a live HTTPS URL.
long_description:
Give Claude a folder, a page you just wrote, or a single markdown note, and get back a URL anyone can open.

A site needs an `index.html` at its top level, or at least one `.md`, `.markdown` or `.pdf` file — those publish as a documents site and are read through a viewer, so a note is a whole publish that needs no wrapping in HTML.

Signing in happens in a browser window; no token is pasted by hand and no command line is involved.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Signs in through a browser on this machine and stores an access token.

tools.name: login_code
tools.description: Signs in with a short code where no browser can be opened on this machine.

tools.name: publish_files
tools.description: Publishes files written in the conversation as a site, and returns its URL.

tools.name: publish_dir
tools.description: Publishes a folder of static files from disk, and returns its URL.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the sites on this account, so a publish can go to one of them.
